parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number, starting from 1. If this parameter is not specified or is set to a value less than or equal to 0, page 1 is returned.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of job definitions per page. If this parameter is not specified or is set to a value less than or equal to 0, the default value 50 is used. Maximum value: 200.
